steps.name: New WCAG AA violations on https://www.musticker.com/kr/stickers. If one is a genuine, tracked defect, add it to KNOWN_STOREFRONT_VIOLATIONS in tests/fixtures/axe.ts with a note saying what is wrong.

"button-name" now matches 5 elements on https://www.musticker.com/kr/stickers, above the 12 recorded in KNOWN_STOREFRONT_VIOLATIONS. Known cause: Icon-only buttons whose only child is an aria-hidden SVG and which carry no aria-label: the global notice bar's prev/next/close controls (3, on every page) and the product page's .faq-section-card-button expanders (5). A screen reader announces these as bare "button".
